name: Admin Document Tags Management
description: Admin manages tags in TagManagerModal: create tag with name and color (POST /api/document-tags/create/), rename (PATCH /api/document-tags/:id/update/), delete with confirm (DELETE /api/document-tags/:id/delete/). Tag chip filtering is covered by admin-document-folders; tag CRUD is not.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 3): create with color, inline rename, delete behind native confirm + dismissed branch over mocked API.
